name: pit-tv
description: PIT TV — a self-hosted concert clip archive. No build step; this manifest exists so the QA tools have a home for their one dev dependency and a single test command.

scripts.test:tools: node tools/check-catalog.mjs && node tools/check-sync.mjs && node tools/qa-prefs-restore.mjs
scripts.test:browser: playwright install chromium && node tools/qa-browser-check.mjs && node tools/qa-contrast.mjs
